reading_depth.main: Complete substantive article body, all six tables and seven figure legends, through Methods/Disclosures/Acknowledgments/Footnotes; bibliography not independently appraised. Source retained as full PMC HTML, readable text derived with HTMLParser without deleting scientific inequalities.
reading_depth.supplement_scope: Complete Table1 and legend; Table2 heading, Bub1b row and legend; Table3 heading, Bub1b row and legend. No whole538-gene-table review claimed.

model.lesion: Podocyte-specific human nonphosphorylatable AA-4E-BP1 transgene limiting hypertrophic adaptation; not BUB1B deficiency.
model.early_study: Male rats nephrectomized or sham-operated at100g; random assignment day1; three-week tissue cohorts n5–7/group.
model.long_study: Figures2–5 at12–14weeks after nephrectomy; exact long-term per-arm n not located in main text/legends or relevant supplement pages. Do not transfer the three-week n.
model.histology: Masson trichrome adhesions/scarring scored by blinded observer; global experimental blinding/allocation concealment not stated.

interventions.source_supplier: LC Laboratories; no catalogSKU or salt identity given
interventions.vehicle: Ethanol stock100mg/mL diluted to1mg/mL in water/5%Tween80/5%PEG; vehicle control described. Final ethanol fraction not explicitly stated.
interventions.late_start: day21; Results mentions once-weekly effectiveness, Figure5 does not label frequency per curve

early_alternate_day_results.creatinine_clearance: Higher body-weight-normalized clearance than untreated, Figure3H **P<.01
early_alternate_day_results.target_measurement: Phospho-S6 immunofluorescence largely suppressed, qualitative Figure3E; no totalS6 denominator/densitometry.

early_weekly_results.clearance_proteinuria_adhesions: No statistically significant difference versus untreated in3H/3C/3G, despite directional changes; do not call equivalent protection

interventions.late_results: Figure5 supports lower proteinuria/kidney weight/adhesions for delayed drug, with reduced protection versus early initiation. Delayed-arm creatinine clearance is not shown.

early_results.body_weight: No significant difference,Figure4A; not an equivalence/safety result

interventions.late_results: Partial proteinuria/adhesion reduction inFigure5; no delayed clearance panel. No proof that renal growth alone mediates benefit independently of blood-pressure effects.

bub1b.measurement: Bulk isolated glomerular Affymetrix RNA; not protein or per-cell expression
bub1b.qualification: Genes selected as P<.05 and changed in same direction across interventions; individual gene P-values not displayed. Reduced cell cycling and cell-composition changes prevent interpretation as direct drug-induced per-cell BUBR1 loss or causal rescue.

diet_context.table1_population: Adult heterozygous AA-4E-BP1 rats nephrectomized at~300g, different cohort; n5–8 per arm
diet_context.reported_observations: 20%and40%calorie reduction protected renal endpoints;24h urinary creatinine fell16%and24%, respectively. This is an indirect muscle-mass proxy, not measured strength or imaging-derived muscle loss. Low-protein and high-fat diets are compound dietary conditions, not isolated-molecule efficacy. Sucrose addition abolished partial high-fat protection in this cohort.
diet_context.late20percent_reduction: Figure5A/C: delayed20% calorie reduction did not significantly lower proteinuria or adhesions. Figure5B shows lower kidney weight, P<.05. Do not transfer early/full-restriction protection to every delayed endpoint.

limits: Creatinine clearance normalized perkg, not absolute measured GFR; body-weight changes complicate rapamycin interpretation.
No raw individual-animal outcomes retrieved; long-term arm denominators unresolved.
No human intervention or pediatric-MVA therapeutic window established.
Dose-frequency differences and late-start endpoints must not be pooled.
Renal protection does not supply a BUBR1-restoration mechanism or muscle benefit; no matching proteinuric hypertrophic glomerular lesion is established for this case.

decision.rapamycin: Add qualified organ-function precedent to existing conditional probe; do not transfer efficacy to everolimus or all exposure schedules.
decision.enalapril: Retain renal-mechanism reserve for a separately demonstrated matching phenotype; no current restoration or muscle-lead election.
decision.comparative_standard: Niacin/apitegromab are also unproved in MVA; this study is neither a head-to-head comparison nor a numerical ranking.
next_questions: Resolve long-term group sizes and drug schedules.
Qualify any relevant renal phenotype independently of MVA label.
Separate blood-pressure/growth effects and directly measure productive tissue function and fidelity in appropriate models.

publication_status.interpretation: Linked editorial is not a correction or independent experiment; not read here. No correction/retraction link returned by this metadata check.

independent_check: A second reader checked the main Methods/Results and Figures3-5 plus selected supplement pages. The delayed calorie-restriction statement was narrowed: kidney weight decreased, while proteinuria and adhesions were nonsignificant. This was a targeted check, not a second complete-paper review.
